violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the sanitizing solution for the (3-bay sink (bar area) and 2-bay sink (kitchen)). New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (wine cooler and 2 door cooler doors) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

The facility is lacking a mop sink. At least one mop sink or one curbed cleaning facility equipped with a floor drain must be provided and conveniently located for the cleaning of mops or similar wet floor cleaning tools and for the disposal of mop water and similar liquid waste. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

The outside dumpster is not covered/closed. Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered/closed and dumpster area shall be maintained cleaned as often as needed. New Violation. Correct By: 10/29/2026

The door to the outside, located in the front of the establishment, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 02/13/2025
Tabletop ice machine was observed with a crack in the cover. Equipment to be in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 01/30/2025
Mop sink observed leaking at discharge pipe. PIC informed. Equipment to be in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 02/03/2025

Some areas of the ceiling in the restroom and in the kitchen area were observed in poor repair (previous water damage and/or chipped). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 02/27/2025
